title: Star Wars Invasion #1 Dark Horse 2009 Luke Skywalker Yuuzhan Vong Tom Taylor
conditionDescription: Creased/torn upper left corner on the back cover, light edge wear on the front. See photos.
descriptionText:
Star Wars: Invasion #1 (2009), Dark Horse Comics. "It's not your galaxy anymore, Luke Skywalker!" The Yuuzhan Vong invasion. Written by Tom Taylor, art by Colin Wilson. Direct sales, $2.99 cover price.

Back cover: Nintendo Wii Punch-Out!! ad.

Condition: the upper left corner of the back cover is creased and torn (see close-up photos); light edge wear on the front.

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
